scope: Independent static review of exact uncommitted missing-envelope correction, diagnostic retention, fixture and documentation changes; no source edits, tests, provider calls, commits or release actions by reviewer.
verdict: No blocking or should-fix finding in this exact diff. Full root-owned gates and committed exact-head review/release evidence remain required.
behavior: Service rejects answer-mode EOF/partial sentinel before citation resolution and before completion. Validated not-disclosed returns before the guard; explicit empty citation arrays retain normal uncited completion semantics.
Missing envelope produces the unchanged generic publication error. Router completion-only metering does not convert the quota reservation; existing shielded release remains intact.

All current _UnpublishableAnswer raise sites use application-owned literal reasons. The warning does not include candidate excerpts/prose through this exception path; public error text remains unchanged.

Eval observer forwards original messages, tool schema, callbacks and kwargs; records only wrapper candidate deltas, type-only error/activity controls and actual service error/complete events. It excludes provider error payload strings; candidate capture is not raw HTTP or finish_reason evidence.

AsyncExitStack owns the service generator and registers each observed provider generator. LIFO exit awaits observed provider closure before service closure on early service error; aclosing then closes the original provider. The patch context restores the original method on success/error/cancellation.

Only runner _answer changed at function AST level. Cohort plan, validate_report, run denominator, scoring, model/prompt settings and golden set remain unchanged. Rejected answerable output remains an error and cannot become a pass.

Positive provenance, repair, paired-claim and existing trace fixtures now provide complete empty citation envelopes; their financial/tool assertions remain unchanged. New five-outcome owner tests preserve exact candidate text and cover success, malformed declaration, missing envelope, provider error and cancellation.

Documentation identifies the original no-envelope compatibility exception and prospective correction honestly; does not promote source matching, empty-citation answers or ND to semantic quality acceptance.

refutation_passes.pass_2: Followed warning/public-event paths: only the controlled exception reaches warning; client receives fixed _PUBLICATION_ERROR. Generic logger.exception path is pre-existing and not expanded.

refutation_passes.pass_1: AST comparison isolates _answer; unchanged terminal validation/raise branches and unchanged scorer/report acceptance preserve failure semantics.
refutation_passes.pass_2: Followed early error and cancellation unwinding: registered async generator closure plus aclosing(original_stream), then service closure; with observer restores global method. Reviewed retained five-outcome owner evidence without running it.
refutation_passes.result: Refuted for current sequential eval runner; no concurrency expansion is introduced.
